claims.statement: docs-lint is a procedure-and-checklist skill with no bundled executable script; its inputs are declared read-only and its writes are constrained to a lint report plus minimal edits to AKSK-owned files (.agents/AGENTS.md, playbooks, curated page content), never to OpenWiki-owned directory indexes, run metadata, or content inside marker blocks except via the owning aksk-bootstrap attachment scripts.

docs-lint owns no scaffold templates; canonical templates live once under learning-distill/bootstrap and docs-lint/bootstrap contains only a README pointer, so initialization defers to learning-distill and no .agents/docs scaffold exists.

Routing-block integrity is verified independently per root instruction file present (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md): each managed AKSK:ROUTING and AKSK:LIFECYCLE block must appear exactly once, be byte-intact versus its template, and have link targets that exist on disk; repair is via attach_section.mjs which derives markers from the template via markersOf() and refreshes only between markers (zone-isolated).

docs-lint treats three marker families as independent integrity units: shipped AKSK:ROUTING/LIFECYCLE and OPENWIKI:START/END, plus proposal-only AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE (vendored with provenance header, checked only when present) — OPENWIKI blocks are verified for presence only and never hand-edited, while a stale baseline capture older than six months surfaces as informational advice not a blocking failure.

Wiki-contract presence requires openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md to carry AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT markers attached via attach_wiki_contract.mjs from wiki-contract-template.md; the script is append-only, idempotent and stub-aware, exits 2 with a verbatim openwiki --init prerequisite if the file is missing, and refreshes only between markers on template upgrade.

Archived-change/wiki coverage pairing walks openspec/changes/archive/*/ and requires descriptive outcomes to appear in openwiki/ or be exempted by a recorded deferral on that change's summary page; worked deferrals exist in this repo and lint does not flag deferred changes.

Index and log ownership is out of scope for docs-lint: OpenWiki tooling owns index generation via sync_wiki_indexes.mjs (OpenWikiLocalShellBackend docsOnly:true virtualMode:true plus synchronizeWikiIndexes) and .agents/docs/log.md was deleted; lint reports wiki index drift as informational guidance to rerun sync_wiki_indexes.mjs, never as a wiring failure, and never writes OpenWiki-owned files.

Stale curated knowledge detection flags pages under openwiki/{decisions,troubleshooting}/ that reference retired skills, carry aksk_status: accepted while aksk_superseded_by is set, or have dead aksk_depends_on targets with no matching filename stem; it verifies the triple-lock convention that frontmatter aksk_status: superseded is authoritative while listings add bold [SUPERSEDED]/[OBSOLETE] prefix and strikethrough, naming the superseding source for the fix.

Content checks are report-and-suggest only and do not fail the pass: duplication/contradictions between .agents/AGENTS.md, playbooks and knowledge pages, oversized AGENTS sections, broken relative links within .agents/ and openwiki/, curated-page frontmatter contract (filename stem unique per tree, decision pages carry aksk_status, validated against learning-distill JSON Schemas via validateOkfFrontmatter), misplaced troubleshooting/decision content, and path hygiene.

Path hygiene scans for doubled .agents/.agents segments under .agents, README.md, INSTALL.md and docs; docs-lint reports hits while scripts/check-publish.sh hard-fails on the same pattern, and the pre-publish playbook sequences deterministic index refresh via sync_wiki_indexes.mjs then docs-lint then check-publish.sh.
